items.title: Stryker completes acquisition of ZuriMED and adds the FiberLocker rotator cuff system to Sports Medicine
items.summary: Stryker announced on 26/10/2026 that it has completed its acquisition of ZuriMED, a privately held Zurich company. The FiberLocker System, a rotator cuff augmentation technology, joins Stryker's Sports Medicine portfolio.

items.title: London Clinic partners with Grosvenor Orthopaedic Partners
items.summary: The London Clinic has partnered with Grosvenor Orthopaedic Partners, bringing 25 surgeons and consultants into a refurbished outpatient site at 20 Devonshire Place to expand orthopaedic activity.

items.title: Blue Arbor Technologies raises $10.5 million Series A led by Ottobock
items.summary: Funds will support completion of feasibility testing, the launch of U.S. clinical studies and product development for the RESTORE™ Neuromuscular Interface System Blue Arbor Technologies, Inc., a company developing novel neuromuscular interfaces and next-generation prosthetic control solutions for people with limb…

items.title: Europe’s first robotic-assisted hip replacement performed using next-generation Mako technology at The Princess Grace Hospital
items.summary: HCA Healthcare UK’s The Princess Grace Hospital has become the first hospital in Europe to perform a robotic-assisted hip replacement using Total Hip with Advanced Primary and Revision software on the hospital’s newly acquired Mako robotic system.

items.title: MEDICA 2026 brings the hospital of the future to life
items.summary: The newly designed “Hospital of the Future” showcases integrated care scenarios throughout the clinical patient journey. What does a hospital look like where medical technology, digital infrastructure and clinical processes work together intelligently?

items.title: 22-25 March 2027, 21st World Congress of the International Society for Prosthetics and Orthotics (ISPO); Bangkok
items.summary: The programme for the ISPO 21st World Congress 2027 is taking shape and participants can now start planning their congress experience in Bangkok. All symposia, instructional courses and technical track presentations have been confirmed and are available in the online programme overview.

items.title: The idea was only one piece of the puzzle: what building a business really takes
items.summary: By James Scott, CEO and Co-Founder at Orthofuse When people talk about innovation, the idea tends to get most of the attention. It is the breakthrough, the thing that is easiest to explain. But once you try to turn that idea into a business, the technology quickly becomes one piece of a much bigger puzzle.

items.title: Robotic hip and knee surgery fails to cut overall risk of repeat surgery
items.summary: Two major studies from the University of Oxford, Queen Mary University of London and the University of Bristol, have found that robotic-assisted hip and knee replacement does not reduce the overall early risk of repeat surgery compared with conventional surgery.
